meta.title: AI chat applies a custom prompt to the Vendor Assessments section

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation screen.
Create a Technical Stage, which is the subject of the test.
Work on the Technical Stage before configuring its questionnaire.
Apply a technical-stage template so questionnaire content is available.
Add one line item so the technical questionnaire has item context.
Populate the technical questionnaire, including Vendor Assessments content.
Record the baseline line-item count before using the AI chat.

args.goal: On the current Technical Stage, click the Green AI Icon to open the AI chat side panel, choose the Vendor Assessments section, type a custom instruction in the chat textbox, click Send, and stop only when the Vendor Assessments questions visibly change while the existing line item remains unchanged.

steps.note: Perform and observe the AI chat interaction that has no dedicated catalog step.
Verify that the line-item count remains unchanged after the AI prompt is sent.
